name: skill-creator
description: A workbench for building Claude Code agent skills that get better every run: the four-layer raw/wiki/SKILL/eval loop, cross-skill topic discovery, and an opt-in git sync layer that archives and backs up skill changes automatically.

syncEnabled.description: Enable the git sync layer (auto-commit skill edits on Write/Edit, push if an upstream is configured, and a SessionStart sweep for script-generated files). OFF by default: once enabled these hooks run every session, so opt in deliberately.

skillsDir.description: Directory that holds your skills. The sync layer only ever reads/commits files under this path.

proxy.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL for git network operations (e.g. corporate egress). Empty means direct connection.

keychainItem.description: macOS Keychain generic-password item name to read GH_TOKEN from when GH_TOKEN is not already in the environment. Optional; macOS only.
